scope: Nominal unfilled 1x64 and 64x1 extracted strips with short controls; schematic shared readout and finite drivers/supply. Main column RC uses signed reset-shunt consolidation with placement sensitivity. Fixed-sense settling is a diagnostic; imaging uses free integration. Not a full 64x64 camera or startup/PVT/signoff qualification.

r1c64.scope: Unfilled strip; explicit Magic integrated wire resistance and capacitance; no pad/clamp/fill or peripheral wiring extraction. Resistance threshold 1 ohm, minres 0.1 ohm, mindelay 0.
